punchBlockedMessage: Official punches are recorded on the physical time clock. Use this app for timesheet, schedule, and notices.
homeClockReminder: Clock in and out at the store’s physical terminal. Here you check your timesheet, schedule, and what needs attention now.
homeMonthTotalsEmpty: No totals for this period yet
pwaInstallHint: On your phone, use Add to Home Screen to open it like an app, with an icon and full screen.
pwaLanTitle: Install the app on the local network
pwaLanHint: After opening the store link, use Add to Home Screen in your phone’s browser.
lanShareHint: Official store URL on the LAN. Copy and send to another PC or phone on the same Wi‑Fi.
lanShareCopied: Link copied! Paste in WhatsApp or the browser address bar.
lanShareCopyFailed: Could not copy. Select the address and copy manually.
lanShareWhatsAppTip: If WhatsApp does not make the link clickable, paste manually: https://rh.eletropasso.local — the address must start with https://
lanShareSetupHint: Another store PC cannot open the site? It needs the same HTTPS certificate and hosts entry as your .57 machine. Run scripts/lan-client/RUN_INSTALL_ONCE.bat as administrator (see README).
lanShareHostWarning: You are on localhost — use https://rh.eletropasso.local when sharing with the store.
pendingSignBody: HR released this timesheet. Review the days and sign with a selfie and signature to finish.
dayListSummaryHint: Summary in the app. For full punches and totals, download the PDF.
noDaysApurado: This period has no calculated days yet. When HR runs the timesheet, days and punches will appear here.
timesheetLoadFailed: Could not load the timesheet. Please try again.
periodTotalsOtAbsenceHint: Overtime and absences add different days and do not cancel each other. The period net is Worked minus the target.
hourBankPositiveHint: Positive balance: hours to take as time off or be paid, per company policy.
hourBankNegativeHint: Negative balance: hours owed, to be offset with extra work or deducted per company policy.
hourBankDisabledNote: The hour bank is disabled. Your overtime is paid on payroll (OT 60%/100%), not accumulated as a balance.
noDays: No days calculated for this period.
timesheetApprovalNote: When HR releases the timesheet, you can sign it digitally here (selfie + signature). After that, your manager or HR completes approval.
dataSourceNote: Timesheet is fed by the physical clock (PrintPoint/REP).
